title: Environment access confirmation form
purpose: Let a BU confirm Databricks and Azure access per environment and save collection status.
behaviour: Let a BU confirm Databricks and Azure access per environment and save collection status.
Render explicit empty, populated and read-only states.
Expose app/server interaction through callbacks or adapters rather than global state.

demoScenarios.instruction: Render the supplied mock data and show the normal ready state.
